name: 93215 · Delano, CA
findings: ZIP 93215 (Delano) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93215 (Delano) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93215 (Delano) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
